title: Facilitator- Technical Project Management
description:
**Job Description**

Role: Facilitator – Technical Project Management

(TPM)

Location: Remote (India)

Position Overview

The Facilitator – Technical Project Management plays a critical role in delivering

high-quality academic support and learning experiences to students enrolled in the

Technical Project Management program. The Facilitator is responsible for conducting live

instructional sessions, supporting students through on-demand tutoring and video

explanations, performing quality assurance reviews, and actively contributing to learner

engagement initiatives.

This role requires strong learner empathy, structured feedback capability, and the ability to

simplify complex project management and technical concepts for beginner and

intermediate learners. The Facilitator will collaborate closely with mentors and academic

teams to improve delivery quality, strengthen curriculum effectiveness, and support newly

onboarded experts (MNEs).

Candidates with a strong academic background and research orientation, or those currently

pursuing a PhD in Engineering Management, Information Systems, Operations

Management, Computer Science, or related disciplines, will be given preference.

Eligibility Criteria

* Minimum 4+ years of industry and/or teaching experience in Technical Project

Management, IT Project Management, or Software Delivery Management

* Strong track record of delivering technical projects end to end, from initiation to

closure

* Preference for candidates currently pursuing a PhD in Engineering Management,

Information Systems, Operations Management, Computer Science, or related

domains

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering / Technology / Management / related

disciplines preferred

* Prior experience in EdTech, mentoring, or online instruction is an added advantage

* Strong communication skills with the ability to teach US-based learners

* Experience conducting sessions using Zoom or similar virtual learning platforms

* Strong grasp of modern project management tools and workflows

* Ability to provide structured, actionable learner feedback

* Ability to mentor junior experts and contribute to academic quality improvement

initiative
  
Primary Responsibilities

* Perform all core academic support activities, including:

o Live Lessons

o Weekly Video Tutoring

o On-Demand Tutoring Support

o QA Review

* Maintain a minimum QA score of 80% or above across all assigned activities

* Deliver high-quality responses aligned with academic standards during live support

interactions

* Review mentor session content based on updated internal guidelines

* Provide structured feedback on externally sourced academic content across all

difficulty levels

* Support students through on-demand video explanations

* Conduct interactive Q&A sessions to enhance conceptual clarity

* Participate in community engagement initiatives to support learner success

* Identify learner knowledge gaps and escalate insights to Leads

* Train and mentor MNEs during their first 90 days of onboarding

* Provide continuous process support to MNEs in their day-to-day academic activities

* Collaborate with mentors and academic teams to strengthen delivery quality

* Suggest improvements to:

o Activity guidelines

o Internal processes

o Learning workflows

* Contribute recommendations for curriculum updates and new course additions

aligned with market demand

* Monitor incoming academic workload and recommend shift redistribution when

required

* Prepare contribution reports on:

o SME academic effectiveness

o Live support engagement quality

* Curate emerging tools, methodologies, and technologies relevant to Technical

Project Management programs

Secondary Responsibilities

* Evaluate video support interactions, live lesson delivery quality, and on-demand

tutoring responses as per defined QA standards

* Present structured insights and recommendations to support process improvement

initiatives and academic delivery effectiveness

* Assist in strengthening instructional delivery frameworks, learner engagement

strategies, and overall academic support quality across facilitator activities

* Support curriculum alignment with evolving industry project management practices

and hiring expectations

* Assist in identifying opportunities to improve overall learner experience across the

program

Subject Expertise Requirements – Technical Project

Management

Project Management Foundations

Candidates should demonstrate strong working knowledge of:

* Project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure)

* Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies

* Scope, schedule, cost, and resource management

* Work breakdown structures (WBS), estimation techniques, and Gantt/timeline

planning

* Dependency mapping and critical path method (CPM)

* Stakeholder identification, engagement, and communication planning

* Project charter, requirements gathering, and acceptance criteria

* Release and deployment planning

Technical Acumen

Strong understanding of:

* Software development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevOps/CI-CD fundamentals

* System architecture basics (APIs, databases, microservices, cloud)

* Technical trade-off analysis and technical debt management

* Cloud and infrastructure fundamentals (AWS / Azure / GCP)

* Testing and QA processes (UAT, regression, release readiness)

* Security, privacy, and compliance considerations

* Incident management and postmortems

Tools & Platforms

Hands-on experience with:

* Jira

* Confluence

* MS Project / Asana / Smartsheet / Trello (good to have)

* Miro / Lucidchart (collaboration and diagramming tools)

* Dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)

* Basic SQL or data querying (good to have)

Risk, Metrics & Governance
  
  
Working knowledge of:

* Risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning (RAID logs)

* Project health metrics, KPIs, and status reporting

* Velocity, burndown/burnup charts, and earned value management (EVM)

* Change control and escalation processes

* Retrospectives and lessons learned

Bonus Skills (Preferred)

Exposure to:

* PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, CSM, PSM, or equivalent certifications

* Scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe) and multi-project coordination

* Distributed and cross-functional team leadership

* Vendor and contract management

* Budgeting and resource forecasting

* Project management office (PMO) practices and templates

Education Requirements

* B.E. / B.Tech / MBA / M.Tech / BSc / MSc or equivalent qualification

* Certification in Project Management, Agile, or Technical Project Management

(PMP, CAPM, CSM, PRINCE2, etc.) preferred

* Minimum 15 years of full-time education

Key Competencies

Ideal candidates should demonstrate:

* Strong learner empathy

* Structured feedback ability

* Project plan and case study critique skills

* Capstone project evaluation capability

* Communication clarity for live instruction

* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical learners

* Collaboration with mentors and SMEs

* Continuous learning mindset

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Description:**  
As a Functional Consultant at eDominer, you will lead the planning, development, and integration of our ERP solution, EXPAND smERP, ensuring that each project meets client expectations and is delivered on time. This role is critical in bridging the gap between client requirements and our development capabilities, continuously improving our product, and delivering exceptional value to our customers.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**  
Master the EXPAND smERP system to effectively manage its implementation and integration.  
Gather and analyse business requirements, suggest solutions to modernize processes, implement and configure applications, document settings, and prepare clients to use the system. Maintain high levels of documentation.  
Lead and manage the ERP implementation team, ensuring that all project phases are executed smoothly.  
Develop and maintain project timelines, ensuring that milestones are met and deadlines are adhered to.  
Oversee the quality of support provided to clients, ensuring high satisfaction and a swift turnaround time (TAT) for issues.  
Coordinate closely with both the implementation and development teams to ensure seamless communication and workflow.  
Manage the development timeline, including assigning tickets and tracking progress.  
Identify potential risks early and provide proactive reporting and mitigation strategies.  
Organize and lead project review meetings with all stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.  
Ensure all project documentation is thorough, accurate, and contributes to overall project success.  
Manage client billing related to change requests, customizations, and project overruns, ensuring clear communication and client satisfaction.

**Requirements:**  
MBA (Finance), or equivalent qualification in a related domain.  
PMP, Scrum and equivalent professional certification will be preferred.  
Minimum of 3 years of experience in ERP implementation.  
Strong understanding of business processes and workflows, particularly in the manufacturing sector.  
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.  
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, and Word.  
Solid understanding of basic accounting and taxation principles.  
Willingness to travel as required.

**Job Location:** Kolkata, India

**Perks and Benefits:**  
Competitive salary structure.  
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.  
A collaborative and innovative work environment.

**Contact Us to Apply:**  
If you’re ready to take on this challenging and rewarding role, please send your updated CV to hr@edominer.com for further processing.

**About eDominer:**  
eDominer, a pioneer in business software development since 1995, focuses on business automation. Our flagship product, EXPAND smERP, is a cost-effective, reliable, and user-friendly ERP solution catering to various verticals, including manufacturing and export businesses.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.  
  
  
  
**GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**

***Role Summary***

This role will provide the candidate an opportunity to work as part of a global Solutions Architecture group spanning multiple Agile Product Delivery teams. Specifically, overseeing and guiding the scrum teams to ensure development teams follow the scrum framework values and Agile practices. This role will also be responsible for mentoring and motivating the teams to improve processes and eliminate team impediments.

Day-to-day responsibilities include:

* Applying Agile methodology values, principles, and practices to plan, manage, and deliver solutions.
* Training, mentoring, and supporting scrum teams to adhere to Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Identifying and managing tasks, issues, risks, and action items.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, engineering, infrastructure) to integrate across multiple application projects.
* Scheduling and facilitating scrum events, meetings, and decision-making processes.
* Monitoring progress and performance and assisting teams in making improvements.
* Planning and organizing demos and product/system testing.
* Ensuring the effective use of collaborative processes and removing obstacles for the scrum team.
* Tracking project processes, deliverables, and financials.
* Preparing and presenting status reports to stakeholders.

**How this opportunity is different**

*Aon has transitioned to a product-oriented model and is investing in capabilities like never before. This role will give the chosen candidate a unique opportunity to shape the architecture for our Commercial Risk Ecosystem to drive significant revenue and efficiency opportunities across all countries where Aon operates.*

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* 15+ years demonstrated IT experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a relevant field preferred.
* Certified scrum master, SAFe preferred.
* 5+ years of experience as a scrum master or in a similar role.
* Working knowledge of Agile methodology, techniques, and frameworks, such as Scrum or Kanban, to deliver solutions.
* Leadership and management experience.
* Excellent people and project management skills.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**How we support our colleagues**

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our Agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative, diverse workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status.

description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


? The Scrum Master is a servant\-leader for the Scrum Team and as this is an Individual Contributor role the Scrum Master leads from a position of influence. The Scrum Master helps the team to understand Scrum theory and values. They act as the conscience on the Scrum team ensuring team members live agile values and principles and follow agreed Scrum processes practices and behaviors. Scrum masters are committed to the Scrum foundation and values but remain flexible and open to opportunities for the team to improve their velocity.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------


? Guiding the team and organization on how to adopt Agile/Scrum practices processes and values.? Removing impediments or guiding the team to remove impediments by finding the right personnel to remove the impediment.? Building a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame retribution or being judged with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving.? Facilitating getting the work done without coercion assigning or dictating the work.? Facilitating discussion decision making and conflict resolution.? Facilitating team ceremonies such as the daily stand\-up sprint planning end of sprint demo and retrospective meetings.? Qualifications:
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**  

* Guiding the team and organization on how to adopt Agile/Scrum practices processes and values, removing impediments or guiding the team to remove impediments by finding the right personnel to remove the impediment.
* Building a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame retribution or being judged with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving.
* Facilitating getting the work done without coercion assigning or dictating the work.
* Facilitating discussion decision making and conflict resolution, facilitating team ceremonies such as the daily stand\-up sprint planning end of sprint demo and retrospective meetings.
* Acting as the conscience of the team especially when evaluating Doneness or Readiness criteria.
* Supporting the team on the use of planning tools to enable tracking of progress with User Stories and Features via Sprint and Release Burndowns.
* Assisting with internal and external communication improving transparency and radiating information.
* Acting as a shield for the team from outside distractions and interferences.
* Supporting and educating the Product Owner especially with regard to scrubbing and maintaining the product backlog.? Providing all support to the team using a servant leadership style whenever possible and leading by example.
* Guiding the team on self\-organization. Assessing the Scrum Maturity of the team and organization and coaching the team to higher levels of maturity at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team and organization.

 **ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**  

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT/Computer Science
* Scrum Alliance CSM certification (or equivalent)
* Possess a rudimentary understanding of Scaled Agile Framework
* Experience in playing the Scrum Master role for at least 3 years for a software development team that was diligently applying Scrum principles practices and theory.
* 5\+ years of overall experience of working in a Software Development organization (Aviation industry preferred)
* 2\+ years of Experience in applying Agile Manifesto in the process of software development \& delivery. Knowledge of various IT tools and techniques for IT project planning and organizing
* 3\+ Years of Experience in practicing Scrum Methodology in the process of software development \& delivery
* Knowledge of collaborating techniques to promote a culture of working together to meet business goals
* Knowledge of Agile Project Management Tactics
* Knowledge of best practices of group facilitation to elicit contributions from others to achieve a desired outcome

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*
